packages.title: Tareas scrolls the new task into view
brief: Context: this is the second attempt at the Tareas part of U5 (P37, b3 round 1; first failure). Verified working, so keep it exactly as it is: the Calendar landing (calendar_screen.dart `_land` with a set of ids, the no-date row highlight), the two-day batch landing with `captureTasksAdded`, the pending list returning to Calendar (captures_screen.dart `showCalendar`, the main_shell.dart listener), and on Tareas `_land` (App/lib/screens/home_screen.dart:104-130), which clears the search and label and selects `Todas`, plus the build-time landing at :342-348, which sets `_landedIds` and `_highlight`.

What failed (ux-tester, App/test/capture_landing_test.dart, test 'U5: on Tareas filtered to Prioridad alta…', 390×844, Spanish): after `Añadir tarea`, `Todas las tareas` is selected and TaskList has landedIds={100} with lit=true, but the new row `Comprar bombillas` is laid out at y 676–799 while the list's visible area ends at y 650 (above TaskActions). It is still there after another 500 ms and pumpAndSettle, so `saved.hitTestable()` fails. The row IS built (it is inside the cache extent), so `_reveal` (:134-168) takes its first branch, calls `row.showOnScreen(...)` and breaks; the jump loop never runs. Probable cause, inferred from the code (confirm it against the failing test): the list is the body of a NestedScrollView (:196). Its inner viewport is laid out at the full body height and pushed down by the expanded header, so the inner viewport counts the row as already visible, and the header (outer position) isn't scrolled either. Calendar works because it has one plain ScrollController.

Fix: in `_reveal`, replace `showOnScreen` with an explicit offset measured against what is actually on screen, the way Calendar's `_reveal` computes one (calendar_screen.dart:119-158). Once the row has a size:

1. `visible` = the global rect of the NestedScrollView's RenderBox (`_nested.currentContext!.findRenderObject()`); it already excludes the app bar and the bottom TaskActions. `rowRect` = the row's global rect (`localToGlobal(Offset.zero) & size`).

2. `need` = `rowRect.bottom + 88 - visible.bottom` (the 88 keeps the row clear of the save message, as now). If that would push the row's top above `visible.top`, use `rowRect.top - visible.top` instead, so its top always shows. If the row's top is above `visible.top`, `need` = `rowRect.top - visible.top` (negative). If the row is already fully inside with its 88 px, don't scroll at all.

3. Apply `need` through the NestedScrollView's two controllers: `outer = _nested.currentState!.outerController.position`, `inner = _nested.currentState!.innerController.position`, `total = outer.pixels + inner.pixels + need`. If `total <= outer.maxScrollExtent`, move only the outerController to `total` (the header scrolls up just as far as needed and the filter chips stay partly visible when possible). Otherwise move the innerController to `total - outer.maxScrollExtent`; in a NestedScrollView this collapses the header and scrolls the list. Clamp to each position's extents. Use `jumpTo` when `MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context)`, otherwise `animateTo` 300 ms `Curves.easeOut`, as now.
4. After the move, wait one `endOfFrame`, measure again, and correct once if the row is still not fully inside. One correction at most, no open loop.

5. Keep the existing build-out loop for a row that isn't built yet (`row == null`): it jumps the innerController a screen at a time; when the row appears, measure and move as above instead of calling `showOnScreen`.
The same `_reveal` serves a project page (HomeScreen with `listId`) and the inbox page, so they get the fix too. The highlight timer (1500 ms) starts after the scroll, as now.

Don't touch: `_land`, the build-time landing at :342-348, the header's content and order (ProjectScopeControl, title, filter chips, label dropdown), TaskList and its `landedRow` key, calendar_screen.dart, captures_screen.dart, main_shell.dart, the messages. Don't restructure the NestedScrollView into a CustomScrollView. Don't edit capture_landing_test.dart's expectations: the failing test is the acceptance. No new strings.
acceptance: Widget test (the existing failing test in App/test/capture_landing_test.dart, unchanged): on Tareas at 390×844 in Spanish, filtered to `Prioridad alta`, saving a normal-priority task selects `Todas las tareas`, and the new row `Comprar bombillas` is hit-testable and highlighted (lit=true), with its bottom inside the list's visible area.
Widget test: the same flow at 2× text on 360×740, in Spanish: the new row's top is inside the visible list area (below the app bar, above TaskActions) and the row is highlighted.

Widget test: the same flow with MediaQuery.disableAnimations true: the row is visible without any scroll animation (the scroll offsets reach their final value in the first frames after the save, before the highlight timer ends).
Widget test: on Tareas with only two tasks (the new row already fully visible), saving a task leaves both scroll offsets (outer and inner) unchanged and highlights the row.
The existing Calendar landing tests in capture_landing_test.dart and calendar_feedback_test.dart still pass.
deviceChecks: UX_REVIEW §7 task 2 on a phone, in Spanish: on Tareas with about 15 tasks and the `Prioridad alta` filter on, dictate a normal task and tap `Añadir…`. `Todas` is selected and the new task is on screen and highlighted, above the `Añadida…` message, without searching.

packages.title: Capture result: a visible Cancelar, and a safe Volver a decirlo
files: App/test/review_tasks_test.dart and App/test/support/capture_fixtures.dart (only if the onSayAgain signature change breaks them)
brief: Context: P36 (b3 round 1) put the result inside the capture sheet: `_review` (App/lib/screens/voice_task_screen.dart:913-916) swaps in `CaptureResult` (:1376-1800). The reviewer verified U4, so keep the result's layout above the buttons, `save-drafts`, the `Ver lo que dije` / `Texto original` fold, the save logic and P37's landing and Deshacer. These are three regressions of P36, first attempt.

UX-456 (S3; R1A-1, verified in code). `Volver a decirlo` is a TextButton directly under the filled `save-drafts` (:1776-1786), with no gap, and `_sayAgain` (:919-945) discards the previous capture from the store at once (`_store.discard(previous.id, _owner)`). A mis-tap meant for `Añadir…` starts listening and the result, with its edits, is gone, with no undo. Fix:

1. Change `CaptureResult.onSayAgain` to `ValueChanged<CaptureSession>?`. When tapped, CaptureResult awaits its own pending `_writes` (edits are written with `_store.update`, :1446) and passes its current `_session`. Keep `_finished = true` as now.

2. The sheet's `_sayAgain(CaptureSession previous)` keeps it in a new field `_previousResult` and no longer calls `_store.discard`. Everything else stays: clear the words, `_projectId = previous.projectId`, listen again, and with TalkBack wait for `Empezar a hablar`.

3. When new words are understood and `_review(session)` runs with a different session id, discard `_previousResult` from the store then (same try/catch as today, then `ref.invalidate(pendingCapturesProvider)`) and clear the field.

4. While `_previousResult != null` and no new result has arrived, `_cancel` (:969; Cancelar, Back and swipe all reach it) does not ask `captureKeepQuestion`. It stops listening quietly (as the existing `_finishRecording(submit: false, interrupted: true, quiet: true)` call does), discards the new, not-yet-understood capture if one was started (`_session`, through `_store.discard`), and shows the previous result again: `setState(() { _result = _previousResult; _previousResult = null; _movedToReview = true; _session = <that result>; })`. The result reopens with its edits. This also covers a failed processing of the new words: the error shows as now, and Cancelar returns to the previous result.
5. If the sheet is closed any other way while listening again (the app is killed, for example), the previous capture simply stays in the pending list, like any unsaved capture.

UX-457 (S2; R1A-2, verified in code). The result has no visible way out: it closes only by the scrim, Back or a swipe, all hidden to a newcomer. Fix: under `save-drafts`, after a 12 dp gap (this also gives UX-456 its spacing), one row of TextButtons: `Cancelar` (existing key `cancel`: EN `Cancel` / ES `Cancelar` / CA `Cancel·la`) at the start and `Volver a decirlo` (`captureSayAgain`, speech only, as now) at the end. Match the listening controls in `_controls` (:1305-1330): side by side when they fit, stacked (Cancelar first) when `MediaQuery.textScalerOf(context).scale(14) > 18`. For typed or shared text the row holds only Cancelar. Both are disabled while `_saving`. Cancelar does what Back does on the result today, `Navigator.maybePop(context)`: the sheet closes, the capture stays in the pending list, and the dispose diagnostics (`leftReviewPending`, `reviewTime`) are unchanged. No dialog and no message. Leave the `Ver lo que dije` fold below this row.

UX-458 (S1; R1A-3, verified in code). App/lib/widgets/capture_review_editor.dart:260-278, `_dateLine`: TalkBack reads only `Hoy` or `vie, 16 oct · 17:00`, with no sign that it's the date. Wrap the ListTile in `Semantics(label: '${l.reviewSchedule}: ${taskDayLine(context, task)}', button: true, excludeSemantics: true, onTap: widget.enabled ? _schedule : null, child: …)` so it reads `Fecha y hora: Hoy` (ES), `Date and time: Today` (EN), `Data i hora: Avui` (CA) and double-tap still opens the date sheet. Apply it to both the main and the collapsed line (same method). No visible change and no new strings.

Tests: update only tests the change rightly breaks, such as callers that build `CaptureResult(onSayAgain: …)` with a `VoidCallback` (check App/test/support/capture_fixtures.dart and App/test/review_tasks_test.dart ~979). ux-tester writes the acceptance tests.

Don't touch: the listening state's layout and controls, `_discard` and the keep/discard dialog for a first capture, the result's content above the buttons, the save logic, P37's landing, UX-451 (it belongs to P40). No new strings, so no ARB changes.
acceptance: Widget test (Spanish, a spoken result): change the title, tap `Volver a decirlo`, then tap `Cancelar` while listening. The same result shows again with the edited title, no `captureKeepQuestion` dialog appeared, and the pending list holds exactly one capture, the original.
Widget test: on a spoken result, tap `Volver a decirlo`, say new words and let them be understood. The new result shows, and the previous capture is gone from the pending list (one capture left).
Widget test (Spanish): the result shows `Cancelar`. Tapping it closes the sheet with no dialog, and the capture is still in the pending list.
Widget test: a typed-text result shows `Cancelar` and no `Volver a decirlo`.

Widget test: at 2× text on 360×740, in Spanish and in Catalan, `Cancelar` / `Cancel·la` and `Volver a decirlo` / `Torna-ho a dir` are both hit-testable with no overflow, and the gap between the bottom of `save-drafts` and the top of the button below it is at least 12 dp.
Semantics test (Spanish, a result dated today): the date line's node reads `Fecha y hora: Hoy` and has a tap action; tapping it opens the date sheet.
deviceChecks: TalkBack, Spanish: on a result, the date line reads `Fecha y hora: …` and double-tap opens the date sheet.
One-handed on a phone: aiming at `Añadir…` doesn't hit `Volver a decirlo`; if it does, `Cancelar` brings the result back.

packages.title: Date sheet: Listo shows why it waits; Sin fecha moves at once; honest labels
brief: Context: P9 (b3 round 1) made one shared date sheet (`editSchedule` in App/lib/widgets/schedule_editor.dart, used by move, TaskEditor, the capture result and the deadline) and one repeat sheet (`editTaskRepeat`, App/lib/widgets/repeat_rule_control.dart:101). The reviewer verified UX-206, UX-212 and UX-221; keep the scope chips, `_setScope`, Omitir/Restaurar, the kept time on Hoy/Mañana, the empty-minutes rule, `_pm == null` with no time, and the `chooseAmPm` check. Four regressions of P9, first attempt.

UX-452 (S2; R1B-1, inferred from code, needs a device check). In 12-hour mode, after typing the hour the keyboard is up; the scroll area shrinks (viewInsets padding, :165-167) and the a. m./p. m. chips (:334-356) and the `chooseAmPm` error (:357-361) sit below the focused hour field. Listo (`_done`, :116-124) sets `_missingPeriod` but nothing scrolls, focus stays, and the error isn't announced, so Listo seems dead. Fix: (1) wrap the a. m./p. m. Padding+Wrap and the error in one Column with a new `final _periodRow = GlobalKey();`. (2) In `_done`, when `missingPeriod` is true: after the setState, call `FocusScope.of(context).unfocus()`, then in a post-frame callback `Scrollable.ensureVisible(_periodRow.currentContext!, alignmentPolicy: ScrollPositionAlignmentPolicy.keepVisibleAtEnd, duration: MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context) ? Duration.zero : const Duration(milliseconds: 300))` (guard `mounted` and a null context). (3) Wrap the error Text in `Semantics(liveRegion: true, child: …)`. No new strings; `chooseAmPm` stays EN `Choose AM or PM.` / ES `Elige a. m. o p. m.` / CA `Tria a. m. o p. m.`.

UX-453 (S2; R1B-2, verified in code). In the move sheet (`moving != null`), Hoy and Mañana apply at once, but Sin fecha in the same row of ChoiceChips only selects and needs Listo. Fix: at :225 change `if (moving != null && entry.$2 != null)` to `if (moving != null)`, and update the comment above it: `Moving: every day chip applies at once (Hoy and Mañana keep the time); elsewhere a time often follows, so they only select.` Sin fecha is already hidden for one occurrence (:215), so this applies to a task that doesn't repeat and to `Toda la serie`. Both are undoable: task_interactions.dart:76-90 shows `movedInbox` with Deshacer (`undoSchedule` for the series). TaskEditor and the capture result keep select-only for all three chips. Update App/test/appearance_test.dart ~276-278: after tapping `No date` the sheet is already closed, so drop the `schedule-done` tap.

UX-454 (S1; R1B-3, verified in code). `seriesRescheduleHelp` (shown at :201-205) names an Inbox control the shared sheet doesn't have; its chip is `Sin fecha`. Replace the value in all three catalogs: EN (app_en.arb:495) `Changes the start of the series and resets moved or skipped dates. No date stops the repeat.` / ES (app_es.arb:369) `Cambia el inicio de la serie y restablece las fechas movidas u omitidas. «Sin fecha» detiene la repetición.` / CA (app_ca.arb:348) `Canvia l’inici de la sèrie i restableix les dates mogudes o omeses. «Sense data» atura la repetició.`

UX-455 (S1; R1B-4, verified in code). The repeat sheet's only button reads `keepRepeat` (EN `Keep repeat` / ES `Guardar repetición` / CA `Conserva la repetició`, repeat_rule_control.dart:178-180), which contradicts a `No se repite` choice; TaskEditor's Repetir row now opens this sheet (task_editor.dart:857). Fix: use the existing `done` key (EN `Done` / ES `Listo` / CA `Fet`) and remove `keepRepeat` from app_en.arb (:354), app_es.arb (:291) and app_ca.arb (:270). Run gen-l10n; never edit lib/l10n/generated/ by hand.

Don't touch: the sheet's layout order, the scope chips, Omitir esta repetición / Restaurar la fecha original, task_interactions.dart, TaskEditor, the capture result, the date picker, the `_missingDate` path.
acceptance: Widget test: 12-hour clock, Spanish, 2× text, 360×640, keyboard inset 300 (TaskEditor's or the move sheet's time row). Type `5` in `schedule-hour`, tap `schedule-done`. The sheet stays open, the hour field has lost focus, the `Elige a. m. o p. m.` text is hit-testable inside the sheet's visible viewport, and its semantics node has liveRegion.

Widget test (Spanish): swipe a dated task that doesn't repeat, tap `Sin fecha`. The sheet closes with no Listo tap, the snackbar reads `Movida a la bandeja de entrada` with `Deshacer`, and Deshacer restores the original date.
Widget test: in TaskEditor's date sheet, tapping `Sin fecha` only selects it; the sheet stays open until `schedule-done`.
Widget test (Spanish): the move sheet of a repeating task with `Toda la serie` selected shows the help text containing `«Sin fecha» detiene la repetición`, and a `Sin fecha` chip.
Widget test (Spanish): TaskEditor → Repetir row → the repeat sheet shows a `Listo` button and no `Guardar repetición`.
grep: no `keepRepeat` in App/lib (generated files included, after gen-l10n) or App/test; no `Inbox stops`, `bandeja de entrada detiene` or `safata d’entrada atura` in the catalogs.
deviceChecks: Phone, Spanish, 12-hour clock, 1.3× text: move or edit a task, type `5` in the hour, tap Listo. The keyboard drops and the a. m./p. m. chips with `Elige a. m. o p. m.` are in view. With TalkBack on, the message is read out.

packages.title: Notes: a new note that isn't in view doesn't move the list
brief: Context: P16 (b3 round 1) added the newest-first landing on Notas (App/lib/screens/notes_screen.dart: `_add` :57-64, `_land` :66-80, `_reveal` :84-118, the listener at :125). The reviewer verified UX-304; keep it. One regression of P16, first attempt.

UX-459 (S1; R1C-1, verified in code). `_land` takes the newest note across all notes, not just the ones the list shows. When the current search hides the new note, or the note was saved somewhere else (a view-only project, where `_saveTo` is null, so `Nueva nota` saves to Personal and `Dictar una nota` to Calendar's project scope, voice_task_screen.dart:477-480), `_landedId` matches no row, but `_reveal` still scrolls to the top and nothing is highlighted.

Fix, decided on data, not on whether the row's widget exists. The reviewer suggested checking `_landedRow.currentContext`, but don't: rows far above the scroll position may not be built yet, so that check would also stop the normal landing when the user has scrolled down (the case notes_ui_test.dart:285 covers). Instead: (1) move the list filter at :201-207 (`isNote`, `_listId`, `matchesSearch(...)`) into one method `bool _shown(Task item)` and use it in build. (2) In `_land`, after finding `newest`, look it up in `all`; if that note isn't `_shown`, set `_newerThan = null` and return true without setting `_landedId`, `_highlight` or scheduling `_reveal`. The scroll position stays where it was. The save message (snackbar) still confirms the save, as now.

Don't touch: the sort, the highlight timing, `_reveal`'s scrolling for a shown note, `_saveTo`, the two creation buttons (P38 merges them), the filter dropdown, and the 'all' case where `Nueva nota` and `Dictar una nota` save to different places (P38 picks one rule). No new strings.
acceptance: Widget test (Spanish): Notas filtered to a view-only project with 12 notes, scrolled down; save a note with `Nueva nota`. The scroll offset doesn't change and no row is highlighted.
Widget test: Notas with a search that won't match the new note, scrolled down; save a note. The scroll offset doesn't change and no row is highlighted.
The existing notes_ui_test.dart:285 test (12 notes, scrolled down, three saves; the new note lands at the top, highlighted) still passes.
